description: Owners only (needs sign-in): Agent-pay to Latchbell: the assistant may pay (shared_payment_token) or the owner pays in Stripe checkout; either way the charge is on Latchbell’s account for this business’s minutes — not checkout_order and not the business’s Connect account. When outbound calls need minutes: show phone.minute_packs and phone.agent_pay (payer agent, payee latchbell). With owner_approved true, returns a checkout URL for the owner. To pay as the agent, issue the token to phone.agent_pay.network_business_profile, pass shared_payment_token and request_key, then receptionist_refresh and check usage.prepaid_minutes_left. Packs are $2, $5, $10, $25, $50 or $100. Minutes never expire and are used after the plan’s included minutes.
name: receptionist_buy_minutes
title: Buy call minutes
